properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.access-token.expiration-ms
properties.description: Access token expiration time in milliseconds (default 3600000 = 1h).

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token.expiration-ms
properties.description: Refresh token expiration time in milliseconds (default 604800000 = 7d).

properties.name: jwt.cookie.secure
properties.description: Whether the refresh token cookie should be flagged as Secure (HTTPS only). Set true in production.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend origin URL allowed by CORS.

properties.name: landing.url
properties.description: Landing page origin URL allowed by CORS.
